description: This file defines atomic operations and atomic types for synchronization in C++, including classes for atomic integers, floats, booleans, and pointers, with inline functions for atomic compare-and-swap, load, store, and increment operations.

classes.name: atomic_base
classes.description: Template class providing lock-based atomic operations for trivially copyable types, including load, store, exchange, and compare_exchange.

classes.name: atomic_number
classes.description: Subclass of atomic_base adding fetch_add and fetch_sub methods for numeric types.

classes.name: atomic_integral
classes.description: Subclass of atomic_number for integer types, adding increment and decrement methods.

classes.name: atomic_pointer
classes.description: Template class for atomic pointer types.

classes.name: atomic_bool
classes.description: Atomic boolean type with lock-free operations.

methods.name: Release_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with release semantics for 8-bit atomic types.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Store
methods.description: Performs a non-barrier store for 8-bit and 32-bit atomic types.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Load
methods.description: Performs a non-barrier load for 8-bit and 32-bit atomic types.

methods.name: NoBarrier_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs a non-barrier compare-and-swap for 32-bit and 64-bit atomic types.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Exchange
methods.description: Performs a non-barrier exchange for 32-bit and 64-bit atomic types.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Increment
methods.description: Performs a non-barrier increment for 32-bit and 64-bit atomic types.

methods.name: Barrier_Increment
methods.description: Performs a barrier increment for 32-bit and 64-bit atomic types.

methods.name: Acquire_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an acquire compare-and-swap for 32-bit atomic types.

methods.name: Release_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs a release compare-and-swap for 32-bit atomic types.

methods.name: atomic_bool::exchange
methods.description: Atomically exchanges the boolean value.

methods.name: atomic_bool::load
methods.description: Atomically loads the boolean value.

methods.name: atomic_bool::store
methods.description: Atomically stores the boolean value.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::increment
methods.description: Atomically increments the 32-bit integer.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::decrement
methods.description: Atomically decrements the 32-bit integer.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::fetch_add
methods.description: Atomically adds a value to the 32-bit integer.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::fetch_sub
methods.description: Atomically subtracts a value from the 32-bit integer.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::exchange
methods.description: Atomically exchanges the 32-bit integer value.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::load
methods.description: Atomically loads the 32-bit integer value.

methods.name: atomic_int32_t::store
methods.description: Atomically stores the 32-bit integer value.

methods.name: atomic_int64_t::initial_val
methods.description: Initial value for 64-bit atomic integer.

methods.name: atomic_float::initial_val
methods.description: Initial value for atomic float.

methods.name: atomic_double::initial_val
methods.description: Initial value for atomic double.
